title: test(runtime): hold clock-derived header values fixed in the /meta action-entry wire comparison
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiQbT4FcQAg8Z3TPX85xEdZz)_

Fixes #31171

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改一个测试文件。`/meta` 动作条目对比测试在比较两次响应时,把 `Last-Modified`(以及 `Date`)头的日期值视为固定占位,其余字节照旧逐字比较。
- 为什么改:这个头的值就是"读取那一刻的时间",精度到秒;两次连续请求恰好跨过一秒边界时,测试就会误报失败,今天已经把 #31142 和 #31149 踢出合并队列两次。
- 风险与回滚:仅测试代码,不发布任何包;状态码、正文、ETag 和其它所有头仍逐字比较,头的有无也仍然比较。回滚就是还原这一个文件。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts` 里新的 `CLOCK_HEADERS` 和 `wireText`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts`,预期 45 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`wireText` in the ADR-0106 D1 action-entry describe of `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts` serialised the whole `/meta` wire (status, body, headers) and every comparison in that describe is an exact string equality over it. The REST cached arm sends `Last-Modified`, and the protocol stamps it with the time of the read (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-search-and-cache.ts`, `lastModified: new Date().toISOString()`), rendered at one-second precision. Two sequential reads that straddle a second boundary therefore differ in that header only.

`wireText` now reads the value of a `Last-Modified` or `Date` header (case-insensitive) as the fixed token `CLOCK` when the value parses as a date. Everything else is compared exactly as before:

- status, body, `ETag`, `Cache-Control`, `Vary` and every other header, byte for byte;
- the clock header's presence and its position among the headers (an answer that gains or drops `Last-Modified` still differs);
- a clock header whose value is not a date (it is kept verbatim).

Every `wireText` caller in the describe (the absent-name equivalences, the `layers` / `legacyLayers` / `published` reads, the member-vs-staff CONTROL, the exempt-vs-unsecured CONTROL and the conditional-read 404) still proves the same thing: none of them is about the time of the read.

Both queue ejections were this header, read from the Test Core logs:

- #31142, build 42383103865, job 128435166865: line 801 (exempt vs unsecured, `usr_system item st_ping`), `Last-Modified` `14:49:31 GMT` vs `14:49:30 GMT`, every other byte equal.
- #31149, build 42385456389: line 785 (member vs staff), `15:19:24 GMT` vs `15:19:23 GMT` (diagnosis on the card).

No nondeterminism in the projection itself was found: in both logs the body and the `ETag` are equal and the header keys come in the same order.

## Tests

<details><summary>Ablation (one-time, the test file mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to HEAD after each leg)</summary>

The member-vs-staff CONTROL assertion was replaced so that the staff read happens with the clock moved forward one second (`vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'] })` + `vi.setSystemTime(Date.now() + 1000)`), with a precondition on the REST cached arm that the two `Last-Modified` values really differ. Run with `-t "CONTROL — a field-bound action"` (3 tests: REST cached, REST uncached, dispatcher).

- Leg A, new `wireText` + one-second skew: 3 passed.
- Leg B, old helper (`JSON.stringify`) + one-second skew: REST cached arm FAILS on `st_rename`; the diff is `"Last-Modified":"Sat, 07 Nov 2026 16:14:07 GMT"` vs `16:14:06 GMT`. This reproduces the queue failure deterministically.
- Leg C, new `wireText`, no skew, `Last-Modified` deleted from the staff answer: REST cached arm FAILS (`"Last-Modified":"CLOCK"` against an answer without the header), so presence is still compared.

Each leg: `ablation-replace: ok mutation landed` before the run and `ok restored: blob == HEAD (784ab7096c9c) and git diff HEAD is empty` after it. The test file runs from source, so no `dist/` is involved.

</details>

<details><summary>Repeat runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts`, 15 runs in a loop on dbd57b69: 15 × `Tests 45 passed (45)`, every run exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The `Last-Modified` the `/meta` item door sends on its cached arm is the time of the read, not the time the item last changed (`protocol-search-and-cache.ts` stamps `new Date()`), so it carries no information a client can use; freshness is gated by the `ETag`. Noted, not filed: this PR does not change it and no test here depends on it.
- The uncached REST arm and the dispatcher door send no `Last-Modified`, so on those doors the comparison was already stable.
